name: R4w Clubbing / Guta & Vince Paris
description: R4W Clubbing hosts a house music club night featuring sets by Guta and Vince Paris at Era Uma Vez no Porto.
longDescription:
Organised by R4W PT, this club night takes place on Saturday, 14 November 2026, running from 23:59 to 05:50 at Era Uma Vez no Porto, located on Rua da Madeira.

The lineup focuses on house music and club culture, featuring sets by Guta and Vince Paris, with Pedro Tabuada also listed on the bill.

Tickets start at 5 euros for community members, followed by standard releases priced at 7 euros and 10 euros.
